_spec.purpose: The variety engine. No two decks visually alike.
_spec.why: Each run records the techniques, palette, structure and camera it used, and the next run reads this to know what it may not reach for again. Without it a machine converges on whatever worked once, which is how a daily product develops a house style nobody chose.
_spec.enforced_by: scripts/carousel/bespoke_check.py measures WITHIN a deck. This ledger constrains ACROSS decks. Both are needed: a deck can be nine different drawings that all look like last Tuesday.

entries.register: night inside a public building, no horizon on any frame, lit only from behind glass and off brass, with one bright paper sheet at slide 5
techniques: an August month sheet embossed into limestone with one cell cut clean through, lit by a raking key that finds no floor
a constant-rate day rule with two spans of one construction sharing one origin, above and below, one capped and one left open
a true space-filling Voronoi bed of identical unassigned panels under ONE raking key, per-edge lit and shadowed, inside a hard neatline
a mid century oil chart table under a low lamp, tabular mono, three quoted figures from two documents
a flat neatlined survey sheet on the paper register, two equal quoted columns over a stack of sheets
four terrazzo inlay courses run ACROSS the frame under one key, each course a different stone at one night value, the seams cut as grooves
an engraved survey title block on stone, every field filled from the record and one ruled empty
a lit cell over a dated list of what is still open, the opening void inverted

palette.source: the Texas county courthouse at night, which every county has, so a statewide story takes a statewide material rather than one place's soil

structural_laws: no horizon anywhere, because the story has no place
one day is 46 pixels on every frame that draws time, and no axis is truncated
ruled means quoted, a hairline above and below with attribution and claim id beneath
no cartography at all, the first deck here with none
entries.camera: one tilted sheet, then a flat rule, then straight down on a bed, then a lit table, then a flat sheet, then straight on at four courses, then a block on stone, then one lit cell
entries.cut: Slide 4, whose water and whose power, was cut after scoring. Its headline promised power and the frame delivered only water, and it sat before the deck's densest frame. The freed frame went to the close, which had no way for a reader to act.
entries.renumbered_after_the_cut: Recorded at the third scoring pass. The register, three palette notes and the camera line were all written against the nine slide plan and survived the cut of slide 4 unchanged, so this entry named the wrong frame for the paper inversion, for both accent fills and in every camera move after the fourth. Nothing checked it, because the variety ledgers are written at ship and no gate reads them back against the deck.
entries.bespoke_measurement_note: 0.5314 was this deck's first measurement and it was wrong about the deck, not about the gate's arithmetic. bespoke_check was still counting the standing masthead, which this run put on every frame: on the closest pair it shared 50 tokens and exactly one was a drawing call. The gate now strips anything carrying a tx- class. RE-MEASURED under the corrected gate, the two earlier decks move only 0.3997 to 0.4061 and 0.2298 to 0.2300, because neither carried that masthead. Their own entries keep the figures they shipped with, which is what those runs were judged on.
entries.rebuilt_at_the_ninth_pass: Three techniques in this list named frames that were replaced during scoring and were caught by two judges reading the ledger against the renders. Slide 7 was recorded as a redaction field of struck bars, which is a drawing nobody made: two judges read the struck bars as an assertion that something had been struck out, which c17 does not support, and it was rebuilt as the survey title block its own dossier had asked for. Slide 3 was recorded as a flat field of identical cells and was rebuilt under one raking key, because a flat frame reads as an unfinished render and its own risks list said so. Slide 6 ran its courses DOWN, which forced four display words to 90 degrees under four near-black plates, and now runs them across. The ledger is the next run's only memory of what not to reuse, so a technique recorded here that never shipped blocks tomorrow from a drawing nobody made and leaves the drawing that ran unrecorded. This entry is now written against the renders rather than against the plan.

entries.written_from: render/render_report.json and the gates' own output, never from the storyboard. The 2026-08-19 entry recorded a technique that never shipped and wrote down why that is corrosive, and the very next run did it again on the frame it had cut. An entry written while the deck is still moving describes a deck that did not ship.
entries.register: a press proof, ballot stock at working distance printed in two plates and annotated in graphite, with three frames on the other city's dark ground
techniques: felt-pen wick on fiber stock, an ink boundary displaced by the same field that draws the pulp
a misregistered second impression of one clause, offset 7 and 3, in the dropout plate's ink
a banded charter section stack running off both frame edges with one course lit
a raking slab with two-part contact shadows and individually lit stacked sheet edges
a bounded hard-edge figure inside an unbounded warped wash that reaches every frame edge
the empty field, bounded by a neatline and dimension ticks
a punched perforation, unbroken, each hole with its own lit lip and cast shadow
the ballot's foot reset as a drawing sheet's title block

palette.source: the materials of a Texas election printing job, with the second city's side on a warm neutral black

entries.red_note: Spent once, on the closing frame, on the event, the date and the hour of the League City council's next open meeting, with a solid rule beneath so the focal is an area. November 3rd is DENIED the red on every frame it appears on, because a nonbinding election is not a deadline and the deck's argument is that the date which looks like the decision is not the one. Measured 5.12 to 1 on the stock and 2.89 on the dark ground, which is why only a paper frame could carry it.
entries.camera: one centimetre off the paper, backing away one readable step per frame, flat copy stand at 2 and 3, the table tilts once at 4 and holds through 5, plan view over an almost empty card at 6, square to the foot of the ballot at 7
entries.bespoke_closest_pair: slide-06.html and slide-07.html at 0.7412, the two pale typographic frames the deck ends on
entries.cut: TWO frames were cut, both by scoring panels rather than by the showrunner. The duration-as-extent inversion went after panel one, where all three judges called it slide 5's argument made twice in a weaker drawing and its own dossier had named the bar chart risk that landed. The county map went after panel two, which found it asserting a county membership no claim supports and a universal negative that is probably wrong. NO CARTOGRAPHY SHIPPED and no county is named anywhere in this deck.
structural_laws: every mark is either printed or added, never both
the two grounds never mix, and the palette is craft and never evidence, so no frame names a soil
an oval is never furniture, and it is empty or filled, never partly
the perforation never tears, because the election has not happened
the stock is new, no stains, no yellowing, no deckle
no numeral appears that is not in claims.json, and no county and no distance appears at all
